title: Houthis Claim Riyadh Airport Attack Hours After Flights Resume; Coalition Says It Intercepted Missile and Drones
detail: Houthis claimed an attack on Riyadh airport hours after flights partially resumed. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile and drones targeting Riyadh. The Houthi claim and the coalition's interception account are both unverified; damage not independently confirmed.

media.caption: Riyadh airport partially reopens; Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missile and drones
